# Trail

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Trail")`

The ribbon two attachments leave behind as they move: a sword's swing, a tyre's mark, the wake of something fast. Each piece lasts `Lifetime` seconds and fades as its sequences say. **A picture, not the world** -- drawn on the frame, simulated by nothing, and a script cannot read where it is.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Attachment0` | `Attachment?` | — | read/write | One edge of the ribbon. |
| `Attachment1` | `Attachment?` | — | read/write | The other edge. |
| `Color` | `ColorSequence` | `ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))` | read/write | Its colour over a piece's life, from new at 0 to `Lifetime` at 1. Multiplies the texture. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the trail grows. Off, what is already there fades out over its `Lifetime`. |
| `FaceCamera` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the ribbon is turned to face the camera about its own middle line, as wide as the attachments are apart. Off, it is the surface the two attachments swept. |
| `Lifetime` | `number` | `2` | read/write | How long a piece of the trail lasts, in seconds, from when the attachments were there. |
| `LightEmission` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How much it adds its colour to what is behind it instead of covering it: 0 an ordinary surface, 1 light. |
| `LightInfluence` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much the scene's light colours it: 1 is lit like a surface, 0 is its own colour at any hour. |
| `MaxLength` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The longest the trail may be, in metres; what is older is dropped. Zero is no limit but `Lifetime`. |
| `MinLength` | `number` | `0.1` | read/write | How far the attachments must move before the trail gains a piece, in metres. Smaller is smoother and costs more. |
| `Texture` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image along it, its U along the trail and its V across. None is a plain band of `Color`. |
| `TextureLength` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How long one repeat of the texture is, in metres, in `Wrap` and `Static` modes. |
| `TextureMode` | `Enum.TextureMode` | `Enum.TextureMode.Stretch` | read/write | How the texture is laid along it. |
| `Transparency` | `NumberSequence` | `NumberSequence.new(0)` | read/write | How see-through a piece is over its life: 0 solid, 1 gone. |
| `WidthScale` | `NumberSequence` | `NumberSequence.new(1)` | read/write | How wide a piece is over its life, as a fraction of the distance between the attachments. |

## Methods

### `Clear()`

Drops the whole trail at once: what something that teleports calls, so the ribbon does not stretch from where it was to where it is.
